text: Across the 11 matched e<=0.5 seeds, the half-final delay (N=256 minus N=64) is +10 or more in every seed (mean about +31), but the 0.1-bar delay ranges from 0 to +70 (mean about +24). Does the size of the per-seed 0.1-bar delay track the difference between the N=64 and N=256 accel_step control R2 for that seed?
